neighbours.label: substitution words ' instead' / ' rather' (X instead of / rather than Y)
fire: The bakery now uses honey instead of white sugar in its bread.
Many commuters take the train rather than drive into the city.
She chose to study chemistry instead of law at university.
The museum relies on donations rather than ticket sales.
We stayed home and cooked instead of going to the restaurant.
The new bridge is made of steel rather than concrete.
The coach played the young striker instead of the captain.
Plants absorb carbon dioxide rather than release it during the day.
quiet: The bakery now uses honey and white sugar in its bread.
Many commuters take the train every day into the city.
She chose to study chemistry and law at university.
The museum relies on donations and ticket sales.
We stayed home and cooked dinner before going to bed.
The new bridge is made of steel and concrete.
The coach praised the young striker and the captain.
Plants absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen during the day.
